This GifOS port vendors:
- the English lesson corpus (start trees, goals, hints, dialogs, solutions)
  as vendor/levels.js, extracted from src/levels/
- a headless reimplementation of the commit-graph engine
  (src/js/git/index.js + src/js/git/commands.js + src/js/graph/treeCompare.js)
  as vendor/git-engine.js — same tree format, same command semantics, no
  Backbone / Raphael / React / jQuery

The original is a 100% client-side visualizer. Nothing is fetched at runtime.
